text: Count of semantically distinct counter-arguments (separate reasons, objections, or evidence challenging the OP's view) made in OC_comments, a JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; title and argument are context only for identifying the OP's view. Deduplicate across and within comments (repeats or restatements count once); one comment can contribute several distinct arguments. Exclude agreement with the OP, clarifying questions, jokes, moderator/bot notices, OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting the outcome (even in argument or comments); generic delta/platform-rule discussion counts only if it challenges the OP's view. Output a non-negative integer; a valid empty comment list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null. List order implies no chronology.
